downstream_api_surface.note: The following exported symbols form the stable API surface for T-0073 (Floor-1 button editor). Callers must import from src/core/authoring-floor-classifier.ts.

exports.name: classifyAuthoringFloor
exports.note: Core pure function — machine boundary Floor-1 ↔ Floor-2. T-0073 must call this before emitting any Floor-1 edit to verify the kind is not Floor-2. Unknown kinds default to Floor-2 (§9.2 safe-default).

exports.name: FormEditChange
exports.fields: { kind: FormEditKind; fieldKey?: string; meta?: Record<string, unknown> }
exports.note: Input artifact. Classifier reads ONLY kind; fieldKey is for audit/reason output; meta is fully ignored (purity guarantee).

exports.name: AuthoringFloorResult
exports.note: Discriminated result. T-0073 checks requiredFloor === '1' before allowing button-edit path. reason is human-readable audit string.

exports.name: FormEditKind
exports.note: Full closed vocab union. Additive-only extension — new kinds always Floor-2 until explicit inclusion.

exports.name: Floor1EditKind
exports.note: 6 Floor-1 kinds. T-0073 button-editor emits these. set_help_text added in R-1 fix (ADR §9.1 / T-0073 spec).

exports.name: Floor2EditKind
exports.note: 8 Floor-2 kinds. Structural — require agent/code/migration. drop_field and rename_field are RED-LINE (human-gate, §4).

exports.name: FLOOR1_EDIT_KINDS
exports.note: Machine-readable Floor-1 set. 6 members. T-0073 / T-0078 may use for validation without calling the classifier function.

exports.name: FLOOR2_EDIT_KINDS
exports.note: Machine-readable Floor-2 set. 8 members. T-0078 red-lines authoring uses this to identify destructive ops.
